transcript.text: Good afternoon! This is Mumbai Bank calling regarding your credit card account. We noticed that your payment is overdue, and the outstanding balance includes a late fee of ₹1,500. Timely payment is important to avoid negative effects on your credit score and possible legal action. May I assist you in making the payment today, or are you facing any difficulties?
Good afternoon. I apologize for the oversight—I just forgot this month. I can make the full minimum payment by the 4th of next month. Would that be alright?

Thank you for your response and for letting me know. I understand that sometimes these things happen. Making the full minimum payment by the 4th of next month is appreciated. Please note that a delay might continue to affect your credit score until payment is received, so an earlier payment—if possible—would help you avoid further negative impact.

May I confirm your payment commitment for the 4th of next month? Also, will you be paying through internet banking, cheque, or any other mode?

If you have any difficulties before then, please let me know so I can help further.
Yes, I confirm that I will make the full minimum payment by the 4th of next month. I plan to pay through internet banking. Thank you for understanding.
